alt: 極年邁而衰弱的老人倚在床上，一手交付家傳小盒，另一手被女兒輕握，家人在夕陽下安靜陪伴。
scene_prompt: 行將就木 means an extremely old person approaching the end of their life, not merely any happy healthy retiree. A tender dignified contemporary hospice bedroom at sunset. A VERY elderly frail man with a deeply lined face and sparse white hair rests half-reclined on clean bed pillows under a soft blanket; his thin shoulders and tired but peaceful eyes show he has little strength left. His adult daughter sits close holding ONE of his fragile hands with both her hands, and he uses his other hand to pass her a small closed worn family keepsake box. A grown grandson stands quietly nearby, expression solemn and loving, receiving his final wishes. On bedside table a faded unlettered photograph shows the same man as a young adult, and a small hourglass with nearly all sand in the bottom symbolizes his life nearing its end, clearly a stationary tabletop object. Window sunset reinforces ending, without supernatural imagery. Focus on respectful farewell and imminent natural end of a long life, no coffin, corpse, skull, injury, fear, visible medical procedures or machinery. Exactly two arms per person, natural handholding with no extra fingers, clear separate hands, bed and chair grounded. No text or words.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D, or imitation of a named artist.
